p.small: do 8.5B numbers describe taste? winning model: k = 50–200 · §1

span.p:
§2–7 SVD · X = UΣVᵀ = Σᵢ σᵢ uᵢ vᵢᵀ
a sum of rank-1 pieces, ordered by σ · SVD ⟷ eigendecomposition of a symmetric matrix
power iteration + deflation · truncate to k ⇒ Eckart–Young: provably the best rank-k · read the σ plot · LSI: singular vectors ARE topics

span.p:
§8–15 PCA = SVD of centred data
rotation keeps total variance fixed (5947.5) · Iris 4-D → 2-D (95.8%) · eigenfaces: k=1 avg face, k=20 identity ⇒ a denoiser
PCA is a linear autoencoder · Swiss roll ✗ · Kernel PCA ✓

p.small: R ≈ PQᵀ, fit only the observed cells · NMF: X ≈ WH, W,H ≥ 0 ⇒ parts, not wholes ⇒ topic modelling (6 topics from real reviews)

p.small:
Gaussian in high-D, Student-t in low-D ⇒ crowding fixed · KL(P‖Q) ≥ 0, asymmetric · forward = covering, reverse = seeking
perplexity 5–50 · UMAP: fuzzy graph · PCA → t-SNE → UMAP
